description: A workflow automation platform with a visual editor and hundreds of integrations.
risk_notes: Creates a Docker container named local-store-n8n.
Publishes port 5678 on this computer's loopback interface only.
Stores workflows, credentials, and the encryption key in the Docker volume local-store-n8n_n8n-data.
n8n uses the Sustainable Use License and is not an OSI-approved open-source product.
External webhook delivery requires a separately configured HTTPS endpoint; this recipe stays local.
compose:
services:
  n8n:
    image: docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n:2.37.10
    container_name: local-store-n8n
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:5678:5678"
    environment:
      N8N_ENFORCE_SETTINGS_FILE_PERMISSIONS: "true"
    volumes:
      - n8n-data:/home/node/.n8n
volumes:
  n8n-data:
